g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does a PulsePay payment initiation request look like?')
sendPrompt('How does PulsePay API gateway validate JWT and rate limit?')
g.text: Validates JWT · checks rate limit (Redis) · routes to payment-service · attaches traceId
Resilience4j circuit breaker — trips if payment-service p99 > threshold

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does PulsePay payment-service process a UPI payment?')
g.text: Checks idempotency key in Redis · validates request · calls UPI / NEFT / IMPS / Stripe rail
Persists to PostgreSQL (status=INITIATED) · returns 202 Accepted to client immediately

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does PulsePay use Kafka Avro Schema Registry for payment events?')
g.text: PaymentCreatedEvent — eventId · traceId · rail · amount · status · idempotencyKey
eventVersion checked by each consumer · UNKNOWN enum values treated as no-op

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does PulsePay wallet-service consume PaymentCreated events?')
sendPrompt('How does PulsePay fraud-detection consume payment events and publish alerts?')
sendPrompt('How does PulsePay notification-service consume payment events?')
sendPrompt('How does PulsePay audit-service capture PCI-DSS events?')

svg.text: wallet.events consumed by report-service · fraud.alerts consumed by payment-service + audit-service

g.onclick: sendPrompt('PulsePay PostgreSQL ledger write for payment events')
sendPrompt('PulsePay Redis velocity counter for fraud detection')
sendPrompt('PulsePay MongoDB audit log ipAddress sessionId PCI')
sendPrompt('How does PulsePay dead letter queue work for failed Kafka messages?')
g.text: DeadLetterEvent (Avro) — wraps original bytes · failureType · attemptCount · validationErrors
Spring DefaultErrorHandler: 3 retries · FixedBackOff 3s · then routes to .dlq topic

svg.text: Micrometer → Prometheus → Grafana · traceId → Zipkin · structured logs → ELK
All services emit metrics, traces, and structured JSON logs on every event processed
